sofia: heads-up, bringing nova-lite-gemma int4 onto staging. after switching to new kernel selection heuristic we see a reproducible drop in factual recall on the QA bench.
sofia: baseline fp16/nq kernel -> pass. int4 + new-kernel -> answers drop to 78% exact vs 92% before. looks like a headwise bias (some heads output near-zero). :thinking_face:
jamal: can you paste the bootstrap command and the kernel choice log? might be routing to a rotary-optimized path that expects different head storage.
sofia: sure — run command I used:
sofia: ```
./serve --model nova-lite-gemma --quant int4 --kernel-autoselect=smart --seq-len=2048
```
sofia: and relevant log snippet:
sofia: ```
[1718492021] kernel-picker: selected kernel: rotary_headwise_opt_v2
[1718492021] quant-loader: applied int4 pack layout: per_head_proj_stride=16
[1718492021] runtime: kv-cache headstride=64
[1718492021] eval: qa_exact=0.78
```
lee: hm, per_head_proj_stride mismatch vs kv-cache headstride could cause misaligned matmul on the projection path. earlier kernels used proj_stride=64. did conversion tool emit a warning about embed projection ordering?
sofia: conversion tool (convert-model.py) printed nothing unusual. I re-ran with verbose and found: `converter: wrote proj_weights with stride=16 (compact)`. we normally expect 64 for this family.
mike: is this model a hybrid head layout (some heads fused)? nova-lite has per-layer fused proj for efficiency — converters sometimes collapse dims.
jamal: can you repro with forcing the legacy kernel? try `--kernel-autoselect=legacy` and post logs.
sofia: did that, results:
sofia: ```
[1718492034] kernel-picker: forced kernel: legacy_dense
[1718492034] eval: qa_exact=0.91
```
sofia: legacy gets us back near baseline. so it's definitely the new kernel-path + stride mismatch.
lee: possible fix paths:
lee: - teach kernel-picker to check proj_stride vs runtime headstride and avoid rotary_headwise_opt_v2 if mismatch
lee: - update converter to emit stride 64 for gemma-family by default
lee: - add a runtime shim that reorders proj weights when compact stride detected
mike: I can prototype a reorder shim; cheap and fast to test. jamal, can you add a canary policy so staging traffic uses legacy for now?
jamal: will do — creating canary that pins nova-lite-gemma to legacy kernel until we patch. /deploy-bot create-canary nova-lite-gemma kernel=legacy
deploy-bot: canary request received: id=c-1718492040, routing=10%->legacy, 90%->auto
sofia: thanks. I'll open a conversion bug with reproducible script + small sample vectors. tagging @lee for kernel-picker logic follow-up.
lee: thanks — I'll take kernel-picker change (add stride check). putting a short PR up today. :thumbsup:
